visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Indoor setting: A young woman with dark hair, wearing a dark blue shirt over a grey tank top and a gold necklace, stands in front of a white cabinet with toiletries. She speaks to the camera, gesturing with her right index finger while looking directly at the lens. (2) Snowy mountain: A person in a light grey ski jacket and black pants is assisted by another person in a black jacket and mask on a snowy slope with ski lifts. (3) Action shot: The woman in the grey jacket snowboards down a gentle, wide slope with arms outstretched for balance under a bright blue sky. (4) Scene shift: A child in a green ski jacket boards past, followed by a quick cut to the woman in grey falling onto her knees in the snow. (5) Skill progression: The woman snowboards more confidently, making wide C-turns and S-turns on a snowy mountain slope with distant buildings and trees visible. (6) Food close-up: A white spoon lifts a piece of fried tofu topped with grated daikon and ginger from a dish of light brown sauce. (7) Outdoor scenery: An outdoor onsen pool with thick steam rising is shown next to traditional wooden buildings with snow on their roofs. (8) Traditional dress: The woman, wearing a yellow floral kimono with a pink and purple obi, smiles in front of a cherry blossom tree decorated with pink paper ribbons. (9) Group shot: Three people, including the woman and two men, wear blue and green patterned yukatas and clap their hands joyfully while standing outdoors. (10) Documentation: A close-up of a blue and white brochure with the text 'DOUBLE BLACK CREW' and a personal planner with the name '陳沐榮' written on it. (11) Final action: The woman, now in a light blue ski jumpsuit, snowboards smoothly and performatively down a slope, stopping and turning toward the camera at the end. (12) Group selfie: A group of four people, including a man in a grey beanie and sunglasses, take a selfie together, laughing and holding up tour itineraries.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young Asian woman with long dark hair, wearing various outfits: a dark blue shirt indoors, a grey ski jacket, a yellow floral kimono, and a light blue ski jumpsuit.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-pitched, energetic female narration begins over a bright, rhythmic electronic pop BGM featuring a steady synth beat. The speaker's tone is very enthusiastic and welcoming. (2) A distinctive 'pop' sound effect marks a visual transition as the narration describes the initial struggles of learning to snowboard. The BGM tempo remains upbeat and constant. (3) A comical cartoon-style 'slide' or 'ding' sound effect plays when a person is seen falling, enhancing the humorous tone of the learning phase. (4) The vocal delivery remains fast and articulate while listing perks of the trip like Japanese food and hot springs, with low-level background laughter audible during group scenes. (5) A final promotional call to action is delivered with high arousal, ending with a sharp 'ding' sound effect as the music and speech cut out simultaneously.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear -> List-based: Hook -> Progression -> Reward -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To showcase the creator's six-day journey of learning to snowboard while promoting the DBC (Double Black Crew) ski tour by highlighting its comprehensive travel itinerary, including food and cultural experiences.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator explicitly names 'DBC' as her tour group, shows their printed materials, and directly encourages viewers to sign up for this year's tour.

high_inference.freeDescribe: A highly polished, fast-paced social media advertisement that blends personal vlog elements with professional travel promotion. The use of cartoonish SFX and bright color grading enhances engagement for a younger demographic.
